title: treasury / 2 year yield / macro | Data Release Other | 2-Year Treasury Yield (DGS2) — FRED Time Series Snapshot
summary: The 2-Year Treasury yield closed at 3.72% on April 20, 2026, up 1 basis point from the prior reading of 3.71% on April 17. The yield has ranged between 3.71% and 3.78% over the past week, showing marginal volatility amid a relatively stable range.
